name: CBo Territoria Societe Anonyme
summary: CBo Territoria Société Anonyme develops, promotes, manages, and sells real estate properties in France. Its residential properties include serviced plots, villas, townhouses, and apartments; and commercial real estate properties comprise offices, businesses, warehouses, parcels, divisible lots, and business districts. The company also owns approximately 3,000 hectares of land in the island of Réunion. CBo Territoria Société Anonyme is based in Sainte-Marie, France.
